## What this part will cover

- Finding primers in both orientations, and removing them.
- Reading quality profiles, and choosing where to truncate reads so the pairs still overlap.
- Error models, including NovaSeq's binned quality scores.
- Pooling modes, merging read pairs and removing chimeras.
- Tracking how many reads survive each step.
